description: This source file contains unit tests for the CcspCMAgent component related to RDK Central Cable Modem downstream (DsOfdmChan) and upstream (UsOfdmaChan) channels. It defines a fixture class for setting up mock dependencies and includes multiple test cases verifying getter functions, synchronization, update checks, and value retrievals for various channel parameters.
